field.label: Tax
field.description: Fault fixture: a blocked line whose resolved record smuggles a numeric value field alongside the block, simulating an attempt to inject a fabricated value on a blocked line (T1).

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes this tax amount from the QDCG worksheet.

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero tax.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero tax because the underlying family is attested closed.

blocked.explain: Tax is blocked because the required QDCG worksheet input is missing.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No value exists because the rule guard is false.
